name: Operational Cost Calculation
description: Calculate crew, equipment, and administrative costs for direct and indirect activities (Updated to cover all 22 sheets)

discovery_update.notes: Two new tables discovered that affect labor cost calculations and team benefits

tables.name: ADM
tables.purpose: Equipe Administrativa - Custos indiretos de administração e canteiro

tables.name: C_FIXO
key_metrics: DELTA = Custo Venda - Custo Fixo (deve estar ≈ 0)

tables.name: DD - C. EXAMES E EPI
tables.purpose: HEALTH EXAMS AND SAFETY EQUIPMENT - Team benefits including health insurance and personal protective equipment
tables.description: Contains health exam programs (UNIMED, UNIODONTO) and PPE costs (sun protection, noise protection, etc)
key_metrics: EPI Monthly Cost = Unit Cost × Quantity × (12 / Life in months)

tables.name: ENCARGOS
tables.purpose: SOCIAL CHARGES/PAYROLL TAXES - Multiplier for labor costs
tables.description: Contains payroll tax and benefit percentages applied to base salary

tables.name: EQUIPE
tables.purpose: Equipe Direta - Mão de obra e equipamentos diretos por atividade

tables.name: Escavação e Carga
tables.purpose: Equipe especializada de escavação e carga

tables.name: LAB
tables.purpose: Laboratório - Custos de laboratório e testes

tables.name: MOB
tables.purpose: Mobilização - Custos de transporte, deslocamento e benefícios de equipe
key_metrics: Custo Total = Automático por tipo + DD EXAMES/EPI

tables.name: QSMS
tables.purpose: Qualidade, Segurança e Meio Ambiente - Custos de QSMS

operations.name: apply_encargos
operations.description: Apply social charge multiplier to base salary

operations.name: calculate_crew_cost
operations.description: Calcula custo total de equipe (MO + Equipamentos + ENCARGOS)

operations.name: calculate_epi_costs
operations.description: Calculate monthly EPI costs for team

operations.name: calculate_team_composition
operations.description: Define composição ótima de equipe para atividade

operations.name: validate_cost_delta
operations.description: Valida convergência entre custos fixos e custos de venda (tolerance: 5%)

operations.name: aggregate_indirect
operations.description: Agrega custos indiretos (ADM, TOP, LAB, QSMS, MOB, DD)
